title: The Wasteland Convoy
author: Silas Okafor
description: Cross an irradiated wasteland to reach a working radio tower before it's too late.

sections.text: The convoy truck sputters to a stop in the middle of the irradiated wasteland.
The engine is fried beyond repair. You'll have to continue on foot.
You spot a raider scout watching from a ridge.

consequence.text: The raider sucker-punches you before you can speak.

sections.text: With supplies in hand, you set off across the dunes.
The scout eventually moves on. You continue toward the tower.
Bruised, you convince the raider to let you pass.
The radio tower looms ahead, but the ground here is littered with old mines.

options.description: Pick your way carefully through the minefield

consequence.text: A mine detonates close enough to shred your leg with shrapnel.

sections.text: You make it through unharmed and reach the tower's base.
Bleeding and limping, you reach the tower's base.

consequence.text: Each rung of the ladder tears at your wound.

sections.text: At the top, the transmitter is still intact but needs a power cell.

options.description: Search the nearby ranger station for a power cell

sections.text: The ranger station is guarded by an old automated turret.

options.description: Make a run for the door

consequence.text: The turret clips you as you dash past.

sections.text: You slip inside and find a working power cell.

options.description: Return to the tower and power the transmitter

sections.text: Wounded but inside, you grab a power cell from the shelf.

options.description: Return to the tower and power the transmitter

sections.text: The transmitter roars to life, broadcasting your position to the last free outpost. Rescue is finally on its way.
